Description: Officers from Rajasthan Police arrested Amit Saxena and recovered 5kg of heroin from his residence in Malviya Nagar Jaipur. Amit Saxena confessed to receiving the consignment from Vikram Singh via a courier service run by Quick Deliver Logistics.

Businessman Rohan Mehta was kidnapped from his office in Satellite area Ahmedabad. Ransom demand of Rs 1 crore was made through phone number 9123456789. The call was traced to a location near Sabarmati Ashram. Informants suggest involvement of Anil Gupta.

Illegal coal mining operations in Dhanbad were linked to Eastern Trading Company owned by Mohammed Ali. Local police identified Ramesh Tiwari as the site supervisor. Vehicle JH02 GH 3456 was used for transporting coal.

A ponzi scheme operated by Neha Kapoor defrauded investors of Rs 10 crore in Chandigarh. Neha Kapoor operated through a company called Prosperity Wealth Management. Investigation revealed financial links to Priya Verma who managed the accounts. Contact email neha.kapoor@prosperitywealth.in was used for investor communication.

The murder of local politician Sanjay Prasad in Patna has been linked to contract killing. Witnesses identified Sunil Yadav near the crime scene. CCTV footage captured vehicle BR01 JK 7890 leaving the area. Phone records show calls to Rajesh Kumar hours before the incident.
